purpose: The command center for modern creators — a single platform combining cross-platform content distribution, community hosting (Discord-like), course creation (Teachable-like), digital product sales (Gumroad-like), and a built-in marketplace for discovery. For consumers, a unified feed experience aggregating all content from followed creators across platforms.
product_promise: Post once, publish everywhere. Host everything, sell to everyone.
vision_statement: To be the single operating system that powers every creator's business — where content, community, courses, and commerce converge.

ai_agent_concepts: Ecosystem AI runtime (shared with EOS/LyfeOS via Tab 8 architecture)
No standalone AI agent system in PRD Tab 1 — AI is utility-level, not agent-level
umh_integration_assumptions: Tab 8 positions CreatorOS as Layer 3 (Distribution/Audience OS) in Lyfe ecosystem
Shared platform kernel includes: identity, permissions, AI runtime, workflow engine, event bus, memory graph
Tab 1 PRD contains ZERO explicit UMH references — written as standalone SaaS
Ecosystem integration exists only in Tab 8 strategic architecture layer
UMH integration is aspirational, not specified in implementation terms
